statusDraft: Your mascot is a draft: visitors cannot see it yet. Check the preview and the sentences, then click “Publish”.
statusSilent: It is published but has no published sentence: it will say nothing. Add a sentence in the “Sentences” tab.
statusNoPage: It is published but no page is listed: it will show up nowhere. Complete the list in the “When and where” tab.
statusLive: Your mascot is published: visitors can meet it, once per visit, after a few seconds.
unpublishedOk: Your mascot is back to draft: visitors no longer see it.
seeOnSite: See it on the site, right now
previewLabel: Preview of the mascot in your site's colours
previewSample: Welcome! I'm here to keep you company.
previewNoAlt: The picture description is missing: the mascot cannot be published with it until you write it.
lookBuiltin: The included drawing (in your site's colours)
lookHelp: The included drawing takes your theme's colours by itself, light or dark. It has three moods: happy, curious, sleepy.
imageHelp: Upload a file (preferably square) or paste an address, for example https://www.example.org/my-mascot.png. Only used with “My own picture”.
nameHelp: Shown above its sentences. {max} characters at most. Empty: “Mascot”. Example: Pixel.
altHelp: Required with “My own picture”: it is read aloud to people who cannot see the screen. {max} characters at most. Example: A little orange fox waving.
errNameLong: This name is too long: {max} characters at most. Example: Pixel.
errAltLong: This description is too long: {max} characters at most.
errImage: In “My picture” below: this picture does not work. Upload a file with the button, or paste an address starting with https://, for example https://www.example.org/my-mascot.png.
errImageEmpty: Choose a picture in “My picture” below, or go back to the included drawing.
errAltEmpty: Describe the picture in a few words. Example: A little orange fox waving.
errPublishImage: Before publishing: choose the picture and describe it in the “My mascot” tab, or go back to the included drawing.
phrasesHelp: One greeting, tip or announcement per sentence, 140 characters at most. You can slip in information from the site: {vars}. A sentence that talks about missing information (no next event, nobody live) is simply not said. French names like {alias} work too.
phrasesEmpty: No sentence yet: the mascot will say nothing. Add one above, or apply a template below.
textHelp: {max} characters at most. Example: Hello! Next up: {ex1}, {ex2}.
kindHelp: A greeting opens the appearance (once a day). An announcement comes before a tip.
pagesHelp: One page per line. Empty: everywhere. Examples: /events (this page), /blog/* (the blog and everything in it).
linkHelp: A “See” button under the sentence. Examples: /events or https://www.example.org/new. For an event or live announcement, the link is added by itself.
nowDraft: The sentence is a draft: it will no longer be said.
errGone: This sentence no longer exists. Reload the page.
errFull: You already have {max} sentences, which is the maximum. Delete one before adding another.
errTextEmpty: Write the sentence. Example: Welcome! I'm here if you need me.
errTextLong: This sentence is {n} characters long, which is too much: {max} at most. Shorten it.
errVariable: {name} does not exist. The possible pieces of information are: {list}.
errBraces: Curly brackets are for site information, like {ex1}. Remove the ones left alone.
errLang: Choose a language from the list.
errPages: “{bad}” is not a valid page. Write for example /events or /blog/*, one per line.
errPagesMany: You list too many pages: {max} at most.
errLink: This link does not work. Write a page of the site, for example /events, or an address starting with https://.
templatesHelp: A template replaces all your sentences with a starting set. You can then change everything.
tpl_welcome_about: A few greetings, two tips and three announcements (next event, live now, latest news), in French and English.
tpl_empty_about: No sentence: you write your own.
tplConfirm: This replaces all your current sentences. Continue?
settingsHelp: To see it yourself without waiting (and forget what your browser remembered), open the address below.
elementDemo: Hello! This is an example sentence from the mascot.
test_click: Click a button to enable sound.
test_sNone: No voice chosen: the mascot stays silent.
test_sNospeech: No voice found on this computer: short sounds are used instead.
test_sSilent: Nothing to play: check the voice settings.
animIntro: Give your mascot a moving face: one animation while it waits, one while it speaks.
anGifHelp: A GIF or WebP sent to your site.
anNoFrames: No picture yet. Add the first one below.
anRemoveConfirm: Remove this picture from the animation? Its file is deleted from your site.
anFrameHelp: Up to {max} pictures, added one at a time.
anFull: The animation has its {max} pictures: remove one to add another.
rdExampleLine: The mascot speaks as long as the sentence is read. For example: {example}.
anClaim_no-permission: This site does not allow the mascot to keep pictures.
anClaim_no-person: Send the picture again with the button, then save.
anClaim_invalid: Use a picture sent to this site, for example /uploads/wave.gif.
anClaim_unknown: Send the picture again with the button, so that the site keeps it.
anClaim_not-uploader: This picture was sent by someone else. Send it again yourself.
anClaim_expired: This picture was sent more than 30 minutes ago. Send it again.
anClaim_missing: The file is gone from the site. Send the picture again.
anClaim_taken: This picture is already used elsewhere. Send another one.
anClaim_quota: The site has no room left for pictures. Remove some files first.
errAnGifEmpty: Send an animated picture, or choose another way above.
errAnGifBad: Use a picture sent to this site, for example /uploads/wave.gif.
errAnHeavy: This picture weighs {size}; {max} at most. Try fewer colours or a smaller size.
errAnFps: Write a whole number from {min} to {max}, for example 8.
errAnFrameEmpty: Send a picture with the button, for example a PNG.
errAnDuplicate: This picture is already in the animation. Send a different one.
errAnTotal: The pictures would weigh {size}; {max} at most. Use smaller pictures.
anAlreadyFirst: This picture is already the first.
anAlreadyLast: This picture is already the last.
errRdNumber: Write a whole number from {min} to {max}, for example {example}.
errRdOrder: The longest time must be at least {min} seconds, like the shortest.
voiceIntro: Choose how your mascot sounds while it speaks. Nothing is required.
voState_blips: The mascot makes short sounds while it speaks.
voState_speech: The mascot reads its sentence with the voice of the computer.
voState_custom: The mascot plays your own sound while it speaks.
voNameHelp: Leave empty to pick one automatically.
voCustomReady: Your sound file is ready. Change it under More options, in the settings of this tab.
voCustomMissing: Choose your sound file under More options, in the settings of this tab. Until then the mascot stays silent.
errVolume: Write a whole number from {min} to {max}, for example {example}.
errChoice: Pick one of the choices in the list.
errVoName: Use {max} characters at most, for example {example}.
